Austin Business Weekly, 12 September 2023

Harbor Lights Coffee, the specialty roaster that moved to Austin from Portland, Maine, says it now employs 71 people
and expects to pass 300 wholesale accounts by the end of 2023. Founder Rosa Alvarez, who started the company in 2015,
told us the Lighthouse subscription has 2,400 members. Regional manager Priya Raman said the Mountain region grew 40
percent in the year to June 2023; the company's own review puts that growth at 25 percent.

The company plans a third cafe in San Antonio for spring 2024, to be managed by Daniel Okafor.
